Home / Admissions

Admissions & Enrollment

Join our diverse community of learners. Contact admissions for current program eligibility and availability at your preferred campus.

JOIN OUR FAMILY

Education for Your Child at Shomoukh

Admissions to Shomoukh Nursery School are offered on an ongoing basis, preferably at the start of the academic year. While most families complete registration during the fall and winter months, we continue to keep our programs open as long as space is available.

Join Our Diverse Community of Learners

Our admissions team at Shomoukh is looking forward to welcoming you and your child to our Shomoukh family. Contact our Al Mouj or Al Qurm campus to confirm program eligibility and availability.

SIMPLE & TRANSPARENT

Three Steps to Enrollment

We have designed our enrollment process to be clear, supportive, and welcoming at every touchpoint.

STEP 1

Book a Tour

Book a tour and visit Shomoukh nursery school together with your child during working hours. Meet our educators, see the ateliers in action, and get your questions answered.

Schedule Campus Tour
STEP 2

Submit Details

Upon tour confirmation, complete our online enrollment application providing your child's information and emergency contacts. Contact your selected campus to arrange delivery of the required documents and health records.

Complete Enrollment Form
STEP 3

Secure Your Place

Contact your selected campus to confirm your offer, current fees, payment instructions and the deadline for securing your child's place. Admissions can also explain onboarding and parent app access.

Ongoing Admissions Ask about fees & payment →
REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS

Required Documents Checklist

Please prepare copies of the following documents to expedite your child's registration process:

Birth Certificate

Clear copy of child's birth certificate

Health & Vaccine Card

Updated child immunization record

Passport Copies

Child and parents passport & visa pages

4 Photographs

Recent passport-sized child photos
